_about: Camera angles for the twin-speaker screen room (void-pair): a wide, a close-up and a medium, so the three read as different shots. Framed with frame_check.py so the cones sit on the thirds lines (Robert, 2026-11-12); focus is pulled onto the speaker so it pops. multicam.mjs renders them side by side, in this order. 'cones' approved by Robert as perfect. Check the picture too, not only the numbers.

angles.name: wide
angles._framing: both speakers from his three-quarter viewpoint: near speaker whole and sharp on the right third (lower woofer on the lower-right crossing), far speaker and screen soft behind

angles.name: cones
angles._framing: close-up: the two woofers on the left third line at its upper and lower crossings, mid and tweeter on the right third

angles.name: medium
angles._framing: one whole speaker from his close low viewpoint, sitting in the lower two thirds with its mid driver on the lower-right crossing; the screen soft above and behind
